discovery.access_policy: Repository-local search, pinned mathlib source-tree search, unauthenticated public GitHub repository search, git ls-remote, and immutable GitHub source archives. Nothing was added to or changed under .lake.
query_families: o-minimal / OMinimal in the pinned mathlib Lean tree
o-minimal / ominimal in repository-local Lean files
discovery.limitations: GitHub code search required authentication and grep.app returned HTTP 429. Every repository returned by the focused public repository searches was instead inspected as a complete immutable source archive. The result is a bounded, reproducible candidate inventory, not a claim that no unindexed or private project exists.

repo_local.negative_search: The pinned Mathlib tree has no o-minimal/OMinimal declaration and no theorem deriving a finite monotonicity-and-continuity partition for definable unary functions. Repository-local hits outside this dossier are Pila-Wilkie assumptions or unrelated legacy surfaces, not this target.
repo_local.gap: The proposition vocabulary elaborates, but the pinned dependency closure lacks an o-minimal structure theory and the finite global partition theorem needed by the canonical target.
